confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Meal and cafe anchors are moderately reliable. July peak-season hotel and hostel rates vary widely, so accommodation is the least certain group. Cocktail and wine rely on their local price relationship to the beer anchor because direct knowledge is weak (cocktail about 2.4x beer, house wine about 1.1x). USD values reflect approximate euro price levels converted at a rough assumed rate, not a live rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: No web-sourced city prices were used. Basis is general knowledge of Porto price levels, positioned somewhat below Lisbon and broadly comparable to other mid-sized Iberian tourist cities such as Seville and Valencia, with July treated as peak season.
